goals.text: On every same-repository pull request, each page whose sources it changed is reread and the author sees one comment on which still hold.
The agent, the action and their docs hold only what that check needs.

outcomes.change: The scope is every page under .okf/ and docs/ whose sources the pull request changed
outcomes.checked_by: tests on a real git repository under tmp_path: a pull request that changes a file a docs page, an architecture page, a stable decision and a draft decision name puts all four in scope with their status and changed files; a deprecated or superseded decision, a handoff, the log and a URL source stay out; a folder source matches as a prefix

outcomes.change: Nothing in scope means no model call
outcomes.checked_by: a test that runs `run` with a model that fails when called, on a change no page covers, and gets exit 0 and a report whose summary says no page names a changed file

outcomes.change: The agent has one task and one prompt, read-only tools, and a pull request comment as its only output
outcomes.checked_by: `agent.py run --help` lists only `--model`, `--base-url`, `--api-key-env`, `--base` (required), `--repo`, `--out`, `--timeout`, `--max-requests`; `publish --help` lists `--pr` (required), `--min-severity`, `--title`; tests that the tools are read_file, search_files and list_files only, that the prompt names `kmctl new decision --draft`, `kmctl verify` and `kmctl summary ack`, and that no OpenTelemetry dependency is left in the script header

outcomes.change: The prompt carries the draft, verify and summary rules
outcomes.checked_by: a test that the shipped prompt names `kmctl new decision --draft`, `kmctl verify` with `--by human:` and `kmctl summary ack`

outcomes.change: The action runs the reread on a same-repository pull request and nothing else in audit mode
outcomes.checked_by: tests that audit mode runs on a same-repository `pull_request`, skips a fork or Dependabot pull request with exit 0, and refuses `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch`; that the inputs `audit`, `prompt`, `prompt_file`, `system_prompt_file`, `context`, `skills` and `mention` are gone; that the agent step passes `--base origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF` and no base-branch worktree; that publish passes `--pr`

outcomes.change: This repository runs the reread on its pull requests
outcomes.checked_by: workflow tests that it triggers on `pull_request` only, both jobs carry the same-repository condition, only publish has `pull-requests: write`, and no Langfuse secret is passed

outcomes.change: The records and docs describe only the pull request check
outcomes.checked_by: an eval row that greps the docs, records and tests for each removed name (`docs-vs-code`, `okf-vs-code`, `okf-vs-docs`, `okf-vs-change`, `prompt_file`, `system_prompt_file`, `--skills`, `--context`, `run_shell`, `LANGFUSE`, `issue_title`, `instructions-root`) outside Corrections, superseded text, release notes and prototypes; `prek run --all-files` green

problems.text: The pull request audit, `okf-vs-change`, checks stable decisions only, so a docs page, a non-decision concept or a draft decision the pull request adds is never reread, though `kmctl review due --base` lists pages of every kind (8 docs pages over 15 pull requests, spike:pr-reread-only/1).

The agent carries a whole second product the pull request check does not use: three whole-repository audits with their prompts (`docs-vs-code`, `okf-vs-code`, `okf-vs-docs`), scheduled and manual runs, publishing to an issue with CODEOWNERS mentions, `run_shell` with its environment scrubbing and timeout, task and system prompts and context and skills from the repository (and the base-branch checkout that guards them), and Langfuse tracing; each is code, inputs, tests and docs to keep true.

The agent's prompt predates three rules it cannot get from the kmctl briefing or the Claude rules, which it never loads: a new decision is a draft the author accepts (ADR 0050), a page that holds is confirmed with `kmctl verify ID ... --by human:<id>` (ADR 0055), and a Correction is followed by `kmctl summary ack` when the summary still holds (ADR 0056).
This repository's `.github/workflows/knowledge-audit.yml` runs only by hand and weekly, so the pull request check never runs here.
